about_the_game:
Stellar Poetry is a 2D action-adventure Metroidvania. Awakened by a mysterious voice, a witch embarks on a journey to reclaim her cursed and forgotten memories.

Build Your Own Combat Style

In Stellar Poetry, you'll collect a variety of unique abilities and craft your very own combat rhythm. Prefer raining magic from a distance? Or maybe getting up close and personal with a flurry of strikes? What about agile dodges and perfectly timed counters? Skills can be freely mixed and matched......there’s no single best combo, only the one that’s right for you. Find your style, master your flow, and rise to the challenge.

Face Mighty Bosses, Trial by Starfire

Prepare to clash with a host of formidable bosses, each with their own unique mechanics and personalities. The current Demo features five distinct boss fights to test your mettle. In the full version, you'll face 40 or more, each with a memorable trial of strength, skill, and strategy. Victory brings you closer to lost memories and new powers. Defeat? It may cost you precious stardust.

Exploring a Broken World

Navigate a semi-open world filled with diverse regions and hidden paths. Some areas are locked behind abilities or story progress, gradually revealing the depths of this shattered realm. Keep your eyes sharp, secret routes and hidden chambers await those who seek them. Treasure, lore, and power lie off the beaten path, if you're bold enough to look.

Stellar Poetry is my first solo development game.

As a huge fan of Hollow Knight who's been endlessly waiting for Silksong, I poured a lot of time and heart into creating a metroidvania that I myself would love to play.

I hope my game offers you a journey full of discovery and immersion — a world you’ll want to dive into and explore to your heart’s content.

Thank you so much for taking the time to check out this game. I truly hope Stellar Poetry brings you joy on your adventure.

— Sincerely, the Developer.

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

short_description: Stellar Poetry is a 2D action adventure game similar to the galaxy Castlevania. The sorceress, who awakens after sensing the call of a mysterious voice, goes on a series of adventures in order to find memories lost due to the curse.

English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
